steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ with login admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}, then in Sales, create a new customer named '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with City 'Benchville' (only the name and city matter), then report the customer's name and city as saved.

02-create: In Odoo Sales, create a new quotation for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose from the autocomplete dropdown). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the catalogue via its dropdown, quantity 3. Save/let Odoo compute, then report: the product chosen, the unit price Odoo filled in, the untaxed amount computed, and the quotation number.

03-open: In Odoo Sales, open quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and add a SECOND order line: a different product (not Acoustic Bloc Screens) picked from the product dropdown, quantity 2. Save and report the product chosen and the new untaxed amount for the whole order.

04-change: In Odoo Sales, on quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}}, change the quantity of the first order line ({{02-create.product}}) from 3 to 5. Save and report the untaxed amount now shown for the whole order.

05-report: In Odoo Sales, on quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}}, confirm the quotation (click Confirm) so it becomes a sales order. Report the order reference (its name) and the status the app now shows (e.g. 'Sales Order').
06-report: On sales order {{02-create.quotation_number}}, cancel it (click Cancel and confirm any dialog that appears). Report the status the app shows after cancelling.
